title: itembank bounded authoring request
description: The strict bounded-request contract of the closed authoring loop (Phase 11, D-07/AUTH-02). The runtime enforces these bounds in code before lint and again immediately before the writer boundary; this schema is the published machine-readable shape. An extra or malformed scope/citation field fails here even when the rest of the payload is lint-clean (11-02 prohibition).

schema_version.description: This document's own schema version; must equal x-itembank-version.

objectives.description: The exact objective identities the request may generate for. An item outside this set is out of scope (AUTH-02).

count.description: The exact number of items requested; the author response must return exactly this many (T-11-04).

item_types.description: The allowed item types; every response item type must be a member.

citations.description: The exact source-span citations that bound the request (D-01/D-07); response item citations must be exact members.

retry_cap.description: The exact retry cap: success on the last allowed attempt proceeds; one more call never occurs (D-05, T-11-04).

mode.description: The permission mode (D-12): report_only never mutates a bank; draft_and_approve requires exact write-id acceptance; full is explicit opt-in with caps (D-13). The model can never select or change this.

per_objective_cap.description: The per-objective cap enforced in full autonomy (D-13/AUDIT-09).

source_fingerprints.description: Optional provenance: the fingerprints of the sources whose citations bound this request (D-17); the citations themselves already carry the exact source fingerprints.

source_id.description: The stable identity of the normalized source document (D-01).

fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 (hex) of the exact source bytes, so staleness is detectable (D-04).

span_id.description: The exact span within the source this citation points at; a claim without an exact span cannot cite it (D-02).
